blocks.tamil_translation: Then he asked, Do you know Surah “Idha zulzilatil ard” by heart? He said, Yes! The Prophet ﷺ said, “This is equal (in reward) to one quarter of the Qur'an. Get married, get married.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- What the Prophet ﷺ meant is that since you have memorised so many surahs, you are not poor, you are rich! Therefore you should get married.
(Aridat al-Ahwadhi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ يَقُوْلُ: اَقْبَلْتُ مَعَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ فَسَمِعَ رَجُلاً يَقْرَأُ قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ اَحَدٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: وَجَبَتْ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ: مَاذَا يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: اَلْجَنَّةُ قَالَ اَبُوْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁: فَاَرَدْتُّ اَنْ اَذْهَبَ اِلَي الرَّجُلِ فَاُبَشِّرُهُ ثُمَّ فَرِقْتُ اَنْ يَفُوْتَنِيَ الْغَدَاءُ مَعَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ فَآثَرْتُ الْغَدَاءَ ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ اِلي الرَّجُلِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ قَدْ ذَهَبَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مالك باب ما جاء في قراءة قل هو الله احد ص:١٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) reports, “Once, when I came along with the Prophet ﷺ, the Prophet ﷺ heard a man reciting Surah Qul huwallahu ahad and said, “It has become due.” I asked, O Rasulullah, what has become due? He said, “Jannah has become due.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) says: I wanted to go to that man and tell him this good news. But fearing that I would miss having the midday meal with Rasulullah ﷺ, I gave priority to the meal. (Eating with the Prophet ﷺ is a great blessing.) After that, when I came to the place where that man had been, he had left that place”.
